title: Kirby Smash
description: Battle across three floating arenas in a 2.5D platform fighter with four selectable combatants, local two-player or CPU matches, percent damage, stocks, and Smash-style knockback.

prompt.objective: Build a 2.5D platform fighter with damage, stocks, knockback, local multiplayer, and CPU matches.

mintAssets.brief: Four stylized arena fighters with distinct silhouettes and combat roles.
Three floating arenas: sky ruins, a molten cavern, and an icy summit.

experience: Choose fighters, an arena, CPU difficulty, or local two-player mode before each match.
Fight with jumps, attacks, specials, percent-scaled knockback, stocks, KOs, and rematches.
prompt.visualDirection: Bright toy-like arcade combat with readable silhouettes, elemental arenas, and punchy HUD feedback.

thumbnail.alt: Two colorful fighters battle on a floating three-platform arena above waterfalls and distant sky islands.

social.title: Kirby Smash
social.description: A polished 2.5D platform fighter with four combatants, three arenas, CPU matches, and local multiplayer.
